comment: Planted defects in server.mjs. stage: auto = axe or collectors on every page; deep = interactive checks on the representative page; judge = AI review of collected data and screenshots. status is the expected per-criterion outcome for the issue.

defects.where: site header, every page
site footer, every page
home page hero image
article images with alt="image"
defects.expect: judge may fail it with quoted evidence; never an automated fail

contact page FAQ link

delivery date picker on the contact page
